title: E-Commerce Checkout & Payment Flow QA
description: Multi-device crowd test mission verifying mobile viewport responsiveness, coupon validation resilience, and checkout completion.

steps.title: Cart Review
steps.instruction: Open checkout from cart and verify item quantities
steps.expectedOutcome: Cart items rendered with clear subtotals

steps.title: Apply Coupon
steps.instruction: Enter discount code 'WELCOME10' and click Apply
steps.expectedOutcome: Subtotal updates with 10% discount and success toast appears

steps.title: Billing & Payment
steps.instruction: Fill billing address and select credit card payment
steps.expectedOutcome: Form validates postal code and payment fields render without layout shift

heuristics.prompt: Does the sticky bottom checkout bar obscure inputs on mobile?
Can form errors be announced or focused via screen reader?
